lines.1: After dinner, we took up our usual positions.
lines.2: Since we all lived ridiculously close, we often hung out at night too.
lines.3: 「By the way, Subaru, how'd you do on the tests we got back today?」
lines.4: 「Hmm? Uh, I barely dodged a failing grade on all of them. Got a thirty-one in history. Just scraped by.」
lines.5: 「That's about all you ever manage, Subaru. And Leo did the same as always--nothing great, nothing awful?」
lines.6: 「A little above average in everything. Here.」
lines.7: 「What?! Seventy-nine in history? I got forty-six, you traitor! Blockhead! Big dumb oaf!」
lines.9: 「Wh... You post-apocalyptic bastard! Mocking a person's physical features... I can't believe you... You're the actual devil!」
lines.10: 「Shut up, idiot. Just play your game.」
lines.11: 「Hmm. I'm getting bored. Don't you have any games I haven't played?」
lines.13: Then, just as I went to sit down...
lines.16: I landed flat on my backside.
lines.18: 「Looks like you've got the clumsy-boy trait, Leo.」
lines.19: ...Craab. You kicked the chair away the second I sat down, didn't you?
lines.20: 「Ahahaha! After calling me an idiot over and over, who knew you were the complete dingbat?」
lines.23: 「Forget the chair--it's your brains that are missing!」
lines.24: Crab rolled around laughing on my bed.
lines.25: I grabbed my bedsheet and rolled it around and around, wrapping up Crab in the middle.
lines.28: 「One Crab bedsheet steam-wrap, ready to serve.」
lines.29: Wrapped tight in the sheet, Crab thrashed and struggled inside.
lines.30: 「L-Let me out, asshole! I can't breathe in here!」
lines.31: 「What the hell? This bedsheet can talk.」
lines.32: I decided to leave her rolled up beneath me for a while so she couldn't wriggle free.
